description: Build the history UI and wire it into the existing no-router public app. Add a history view that renders two dependency-free inline-SVG charts (a line chart of score-over-time and a bar chart of per-quiz average accuracy), a recent-attempts list, and a clear-history action guarded by window.confirm. Integrate it into HomePage's view state machine (add a 'history' view) with in-page navigation to/from the list and result screens, and record a history record via the FEAT-001 module exactly once at the moment a result is shown (in the successful submit callback, not in render/effect). Add matching CSS to styles.css using the existing design tokens (dark-mode + reduced-motion aware) and a README note. Depends on FEAT-001.
steps: Create the SVG chart components with no external dependencies. Suggested location: frontend/src/components/HistoryCharts.tsx (or co-locate in the history view file). Implement a LineChart component: x-axis = attempt order/date (chronological), y-axis = percent 0-100. Use a viewBox-based responsive <svg> that scales to the card width (width:100% via CSS, preserve viewBox). Draw axes/gridlines, a polyline through the points, and small point markers. Use currentColor / the existing CSS variables (var(--primary), var(--muted), var(--card-border), var(--text)) instead of hardcoded colors so it reads in light and dark mode. Add role="img" and an aria-label plus a <title> element; do not rely on color alone (label the axis endpoints 0 and 100 and show point values or a legend).

Implement a BarChart component: one bar per quiz showing averagePercent (0-100) from averageByQuiz. Same responsive viewBox approach, same CSS-variable/currentColor theming, same accessibility (role="img", aria-label, <title>, value labels on/next to bars, quiz titles as x labels). Keep bar widths/spacing computed from the data length so it scales.

Create the history view component, e.g. frontend/src/pages/HistoryView.tsx, that: loads records via history.load(); if empty, shows an .empty-state with Japanese copy like 'まだ履歴がありません'; otherwise renders (a) the LineChart fed by history.chronological(records), (b) the BarChart fed by history.averageByQuiz(records), (c) a recent-attempts list/table (title, percent, score/total, formatted date) showing e.g. the most recent attempts newest-first, and (d) a '履歴を消去' button (className 'btn small' or 'btn') that calls window.confirm with a Japanese message and, on confirm, calls history.clear() and updates local state to empty. Provide a '一覧に戻る' button (className 'btn') invoking an onBack prop. Each chart sits in a .card for visual consistency. Format dates with the built-in Intl/Date (e.g. toLocaleString('ja-JP')); do NOT add a date library.

Integrate into frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: extend the View type to 'list' | 'quiz' | 'result' | 'history'. Render {view === 'history' && <HistoryView onBack={() => setView('list')} />}. Import HistoryView.

Add navigation entry points in HomePage using existing button styles/copy: on the quiz list screen add a way to reach history (e.g. a '履歴を見る' button rendered near QuizList, wired to setView('history')), and on the result screen add a '履歴を見る' button in the QuizResult .quiz-actions row (pass an onViewHistory prop from HomePage that calls setView('history')). Keep the existing 'もう一度クイズを選ぶ' button and all existing result content unchanged.

Record history at result time exactly once per attempt: in HomePage's handleSubmit, inside the successful branch right after `setResult(res)` (before/after switching view), build a record with makeRecord({ quizId: quiz.quizId, title: quiz.title, score: res.score, total: res.total }) and call append(record). Do this in the async submit callback, NOT in render or a useEffect, so React.StrictMode double-invocation and re-renders never double-record. quiz.title comes from currentQuiz which is in scope. Do not alter the existing scoring, percent, or result display logic.

Add CSS to frontend/src/styles.css for the history view and charts, reusing existing tokens: a container/section, chart card spacing, an .svg-chart (width:100%, height auto) rule, axis/label typography using var(--muted)/var(--text), a recent-attempts list styled like the existing lists (reuse .card / list vocabulary), and a per-attempt row layout. Support dark mode implicitly by using the CSS variables (do not hardcode colors) and respect the existing prefers-reduced-motion block (add no motion that isn't covered, or keep transitions token-based). Keep it tasteful and consistent with .card/.btn.

Add a section to README.md (Japanese, consistent with the existing style) describing the new client-side history/graph feature: history is stored per-browser in localStorage (key 'quizHistory'), requires no login and no backend changes, incurs no server cost, is not synced across browsers/devices, and can be cleared from the history screen. Note the two self-rendered SVG charts (score-over-time line, per-quiz average-accuracy bar) and that no charting/date library was added. Mention it is verified via `cd frontend && npm run build` on a networked host.
acceptance_criteria: A history view is reachable from both the quiz list screen and the result screen via Japanese-labeled buttons, and offers a '一覧に戻る' path back; no react-router or other new dependency is introduced (frontend package.json dependencies remain exactly react + react-dom).

The line chart (score over time) and bar chart (per-quiz average accuracy) are hand-rolled inline <svg> React components using a responsive viewBox, themed via CSS variables/currentColor (readable in light and dark mode), with role="img", aria-label, <title>, and non-color-only labels.

History is recorded exactly once per completed attempt from the successful submit callback (not in render/effect), with quizId, title, score, total, percent (round(score/total*100)), and an ISO takenAt, using the FEAT-001 module.
The empty state shows Japanese copy such as 'まだ履歴がありません', and '履歴を消去' clears history only after window.confirm and updates the view to empty.
All pre-existing HomePage behavior is preserved: list/quiz/result flow, scoring, answers=-1 for unanswered, the score-ring --percent mechanism, aria-labels, and Japanese microcopy are unchanged.
styles.css additions use the existing design tokens (no hardcoded light/dark colors) and README.md documents the client-side, per-browser localStorage history feature.
verification: Read HomePage.tsx and confirm: View type includes 'history'; append(makeRecord(...)) is called only in the successful submit callback (grep for append/makeRecord shows no call inside render or useEffect); the result display and scoring code are unchanged.
Read the chart components and confirm they render inline <svg> with a viewBox, use var(--...)/currentColor (no hardcoded hex like #2b6cf0), and include role/aria-label/<title> plus textual labels.
Confirm frontend/package.json still lists dependencies as exactly react and react-dom (no new deps) and no lockfile was added.

On a networked host, `cd frontend && npm install && npm run build` (tsc -b + vite build) succeeds; confirm by inspection that imports resolve and types match api.ts (QuizDetail.title, SubmitResult.score/total) and history.ts exports.
